description: One corpus for JSON Schema and the actual CLI repository. Deliberate schema/runtime differences have explicit reasons; no credentials are read.

cases.name: complete profile with API-named task defaults
integral decimal JSON notation
cases.reason: CLI requires an integer literal and does not coerce floating-point JSON numbers.

cases.name: integral exponent JSON notation
cases.reason: CLI requires an integer literal and does not coerce exponent JSON numbers.

cases.name: version requires an integer literal
cases.reason: Version is parsed as a literal integer by the CLI; JSON Schema compares abstract numeric values.

cases.name: defaultProfile references missing alias
cases.reason: Membership in the dynamic profiles dictionary is an additional runtime check.

cases.name: two profiles share one managed credential file
cases.reason: Runtime rejects duplicate credential references so removal cannot delete another profile's secret.

cases.name: decimal role literal
cases.reason: Runtime requires integer literal syntax without float coercion.
